solution:
Using $\cos2\theta=2\cos^{2}\theta-1$, the equation becomes $2\cos^{2}\theta-1=\cos\theta$, i.e. $2\cos^{2}\theta-\cos\theta-1=0$. Factorising: $(2\cos\theta+1)(\cos\theta-1)=0$. So $\cos\theta=1$ gives $\theta=0$, and $\cos\theta=-\tfrac12$ gives $\theta=\frac{2\pi}{3},\frac{4\pi}{3}$. The solutions are $\theta=0,\frac{2\pi}{3},\frac{4\pi}{3}$.
